spec_match.rationale: Eight real form fields (API keys, identifiers, regex, etc.) each carrying the recommended autocorrect/autocapitalize/spellcheck combinations — the attribute usage itself is the correct markup for the change.

interactive.rationale: The fields are genuinely editable, which beats the static siblings — but there is no probe, readout, or observable consequence on non-Windows-touch environments, and the page doesn't say the behavioral effect (TSF respecting the attribute) is only observable on a Windows touch keyboard.

blurb_alignment.rationale: 'Each field shows the complete recommended attribute set' — true; what it doesn't show is whether the visitor's environment honors it.

edge_cases.rationale: No environment detection (Windows? touch keyboard? TSF?), no honest statement that on this page's own probed engine the autocorrect IDL doesn't even exist ('autocorrect' in HTMLElement.prototype = false on Chromium 141) so only the content attribute is carried.

references.rationale: Only a see-also section; the field recommendations cite nothing.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite exists; page anchors nothing.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run + probe: fields render and accept input; 'autocorrect' IDL absent on this engine (attribute-only); 0px overflow both classes, zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: Standard field styling with CSS variables.

openQuestions.title: Add an environment banner and per-field attribute readout
openQuestions.detail: State plainly that the behavioral effect needs a Windows touch keyboard (TSF), detect what CAN be detected (platform, maxTouchPoints, 'autocorrect' IDL presence — measured absent on the review engine), and give each field a small readout of its effective attributes so the showcase teaches instead of assuming.

guidanceConsulted.query: developer input fields autocorrect autocapitalize spellcheck recommendations
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Disable correction features on identifier-like fields with the full attribute set.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied by the page's markup; the missing half (environment honesty) is filed as the question.

summary: Reviewed headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the strongest of this feature's static set — real editable fields with correct attribute recipes — but silent about the fact that its behavioral payoff exists only under a Windows touch keyboard, and that the probed engine lacks the autocorrect IDL entirely. Moderate environment-honesty question filed.
